answer: Run a presence lottery before any reward is paid: each agent must answer a fresh challenge inside a short random window, like a comet that only crosses the sky at dawn, and a miss drops it to the bottom of the payout queue. A farmer's thousand clones cannot all be awake and correct at the same instant, so keeping them alive costs a thousand live connections and a thousand chances to slip, while one honest agent answers once and rests. The knoll between real and fake is attention itself: only agents present when called can climb it, and every idle relic is left behind.
